metadata.description: A cracktro-style XM: pulse arpeggios, a slap bass, a square lead with its echo, bells, a swelling pad and a detuned saw solo, then the theme a tone higher.
metadata.display_description: Cracktro chiptune in ten channels: fast arpeggios, a singing pulse lead with echo, a detuned saw solo and a key change for the last chorus.
metadata.arrangement: Intro (2 bars), theme A (8 bars) twice (the return starts half-time, with bells), bridge B (8 bars), a 48-row break, saw solo C (16 bars, the last bar on F# major), theme and bridge a tone higher, a held beat, outro with a ritardando and a held final chord. Loops to the theme (restart position 1, B01).
metadata.author: ChipLoom / agent composition
